image_description: A full suit of polished plate armor standing in a museum or display setting. The armor features a highly reflective steel breastplate with gold/brass trim, articulated limb defenses (pauldrons, vambraces, cuisses), and a helmet with a visor. To the right, there is a shield or banner with text. The background suggests an indoor environment with architectural elements.
